description.value: A large Parks Canada campground on the hillside above Radium Hot Springs with sweeping views of the Columbia Valley and Purcell Mountains; bighorn sheep wander through camp, and trails connect directly to the famous hot springs pools and the village below.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the campground is operational, operated by Parks Canada within Kootenay National Park. Key amenity evidence comes from the website listing: kitchen shelters (covered shelter), food storage (animal-safe), power hook-ups 15–30 Amps (device charging at powered sites), a 1.8 km trail to village restaurants (food nearby), and a Book Now call-to-action (reservations). A capacity discrepancy exists: OSM tags show 144 sites while the website states 242 sites, flagged as a concern.
concerns: Capacity discrepancy: OSM tags show capacity=144 but the website states 242 sites; OSM data may be outdated.
Phone number (1-877-737-3783) appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags — could not confirm against an OSM value.
Address (5016 Hwy-93) is from the website only; OSM has no address field to cross-check.

The URL is a third-party Radium Hot Springs tourism site, not the official Parks Canada reservation page; the listing content is consistent and appears accurate but the canonical Parks Canada URL may differ.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A large, well-serviced Parks Canada campground in Kootenay National Park with direct trail access to village services — a clear and valuable stop for touring cyclists riding the Columbia Valley corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The campground also lists recycling bins, fire rings and firewood, playgrounds, smoke-free areas, and a public telephone among its amenities. Bighorn sheep are commonly sighted on the property. The oTENTik cabins may appeal to credit-card tourers seeking shelter without tent setup.
